title: get_page input
description: Identify the page by exactly one of id or url. (Not expressed as oneOf because several MCP clients reject top-level combinators.)

id.description: Page id from search_site or a sections entry.

url.description: Absolute URL on one of this site's hosts, or a root-relative path such as '/about'.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique within its collection on this site.
